name: visionguard-site
description: Vision Guard — bilingual AR/EN site, on-site shop and staff attendance. Static front end, Cloudflare Pages Functions + D1 behind it. No build step.

scripts.db:orders: wrangler d1 execute visionguardegdata --remote --command "SELECT id, created_at, name, phone, governorate, total, status, notified, notify_error FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20"
scripts.db:order: wrangler d1 execute visionguardegdata --remote --command "SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1"
scripts.db:attendance: wrangler d1 execute visionguardegdata --remote --command "SELECT u.name, a.work_date, a.clock_in, a.clock_out, a.seconds FROM attendance a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id ORDER BY a.clock_in DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.db:newsletter: wrangler d1 execute visionguardegdata --remote --command "SELECT email, name, marketing, source, created_at, unsub_at FROM newsletter ORDER BY created_at DESC"
scripts.db:staff: wrangler d1 execute visionguardegdata --remote --command "SELECT name, email, role FROM users WHERE lower(email) LIKE '%@visionguardeg.com' ORDER BY role, name"

//type: Every .js in this repo is already an ES module — the front end, lib/ and functions/ all use import/export. Saying so lets plain `node` run scripts/ against lib/ instead of guessing the module kind from the file's contents, which older Node versions do not do.
